On October 11, our team visited families whose tents had been burned, leaving them without shelter once again. Even as we filmed, heavy gunfire echoed around us. This is the reality of life in Gaza. Families who have lost everything continue to live under the threat of violence, yet refuse to be driven from their land. This is what steadfastness looks like. Sumud. A determination that is difficult to comprehend unless you understand what it means to face the loss of your homeland. They have burned their shelters, destroyed their neighborhoods, and displaced them again and again. But they have not broken their connection to Palestine. They are not leaving. videos.caption: Palestine 1945🇵🇸💖 Palestine,[i][g] officially the State of Palestine,[ii] is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia. Situated between the Mediterranean Sea and Jordan River, it comprises the territories of the West Bank and the Gaza Strip, both of which are under occupation by Israel. Palestine shares the majority of its borders with Israel, while the West Bank borders Jordan to the east and the Gaza Strip borders Egypt to the southwest. The West Bank is divided between 165 Palestinian enclaves under partial civilian rule by the Palestinian Authority, and Area C, under full Israeli control. Palestine's population exceeds five million; its proclaimed capital is Jerusalem, while Ramallah serves as its de facto administrative center. Situated at a continental crossroad, the Palestine region was ruled by various empires and experienced various demographic changes from antiquity to the modern era. The region has religious significance. The ongoing Israeli–Palestinian conflict dates back to the rise of the Zionist movement, supported by the United Kingdom during World War I. The war saw Britain occupying Palestine from the Ottoman Empire, where it set up Mandatory Palestine under the auspices of the League of Nations. Increased Jewish immigration led to intercommunal conflict between Jews and Palestinian Arabs, which escalated into a civil war in 1947 after a proposed partitioning by the United Nations was rejected by the Palestinians and other Arab nations. The 1948 Palestine war saw the forcible displacement of a majority of the Arab population, and consequently the establishment of Israel; these events are referred to by Palestinians as the Nakba ('catastrophe'). In the Six-Day War in 1967, Israel occupied the West Bank and the Gaza Strip, which had been held by Jordan and Egypt respectively. The Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) declared independence in 1988. In 1993, the PLO signed the Oslo Accords with Israel, creating limited PLO governance in the West Bank and Gaza Strip through the Palestinian Authority (PA). Israel withdrew from Gaza in its unilateral disengagement in 2005. In 2007, internal divisions between political factions led to a takeover of Gaza by Hamas. Since then, the West Bank has been governed in part by the Fatah-led PA, while the Gaza Strip has remained under the control of Hamas. #fyp #xyzbca #palestine #🇵🇸 #edit

There is something deeply heartbreaking about a little girl in Gaza who has already learned to carry responsibilities that most adults would struggle with, yet still finds the innocence to smile when someone points a camera at her. For a brief moment, she forgets what she’s carrying. She’s just a little girl, happy to be noticed, perhaps excited to see herself on someone’s phone. The kind of ordinary, beautiful reaction you would expect from any child her age. But then you remember where she is. You remember that while children elsewhere are choosing which toys to play with, she is navigating a world where even the simplest necessities require effort, patience, and strength. I wonder what her life would look like if she had been born into peace. What her mornings would sound like. What games she would play. What little things would make her laugh until her stomach hurt. And I hope that one day, she gets to discover all of it. Because the most beautiful thing about her smile isn’t how much suffering she can endure. It’s the little girl who is still there, waiting for a world that will finally let her enjoy being a child. 🇵🇸❤️ #palestine #gaza #fyp #freepalestine #humanity

They told you the war was over. They told you everything had ended. But please, don’t look away from Gaza. 💔🇵🇸 People are still living among the ruins of their homes. Children are still growing up surrounded by fear, the sounds of explosions, and the pain of losing the people and places they love. Families are struggling to find food, clean water, shelter, and the most basic necessities of life. Here in Gaza, even the simplest things have become a daily struggle. Many families still live in tents that cannot protect them from the cold or the heat. Parents worry about how to feed their children, and children are being deprived of the childhood they deserve. So, what exactly has ended? Our suffering has not disappeared just because the world has stopped talking about it. We are still here, still struggling, and still hoping someone will hear our voices. Please don’t forget Gaza. Please don’t let the world move on while families are still struggling to survive. Share our story. Let the world see what life is really like here. 🤍
